key_findings: Intracerebroventricular anti-CGRP antibody attenuates orofacial mechanical and heat hypersensitivity after infraorbital nerve ligation and reduces pERK in Vc.
CGRP immunoreactivity in Vc rises after nerve ligation and falls with antibody.
